title: One system for your entire investing workflow.
subtitle: DISU brings Portfolio, Sentiment, Quant, and Primers into one flow so you can move from signal to decision faster.

features.title: Portfolio as your source of truth
features.description: Connect brokers, sync positions, and keep a live overview of your holdings.

features.title: Sentiment with market context
features.description: Track market tone around a ticker and separate signal from noise before you act.

features.title: Primers from filings
features.description: Generate concise company briefs from 10-K and 10-Q filings in minutes.

features.title: Quant scenarios for decisions
features.description: Model short- and medium-term price scenarios with probabilities to support investment decisions.
